kb-01.title: Plan prices
kb-01.text: The Basic plan costs $12 a month and the Plus plan costs $15 a month. Paying yearly instead of monthly saves 20%.

kb-02.title: Payment methods
kb-02.text: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express and PayPal. Bank transfer is available for yearly plans only.

kb-03.title: Failed payments
kb-03.text: If a payment fails, we retry it 3 times over 7 days. If all three retries fail, your account is paused until the payment goes through.

kb-04.title: Invoices
kb-04.text: Invoices are emailed on the 1st of each month. You can also download every past invoice from Settings > Billing.

kb-05.title: Currency and tax
kb-05.text: Prices are charged in US dollars. Customers in Canada can switch their billing currency to Canadian dollars in Settings > Billing. Sales tax is added at checkout.

kb-06.title: Cancelling auto-renew
kb-06.text: Turn off auto-renew in Settings > Billing > Auto-renew. Your plan stays active until the end of the period you paid for. We don't give partial refunds for unused time.

kb-07.title: Delivery times
kb-07.text: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days to major cities.

kb-08.title: Shipping costs
kb-08.text: Standard shipping is free on orders over $50. Express shipping costs $15.

kb-09.title: Tracking your order
kb-09.text: We email a tracking number within 24 hours of your order shipping. It can take up to 48 hours for the courier's tracking page to show updates.

kb-10.title: Changing the delivery address
kb-10.text: You can change the delivery address until the order ships, from Orders > Edit address. After it ships, the address can't be changed.

kb-11.title: Rural areas and territories
kb-11.text: We ship to Yukon, the Northwest Territories and Nunavut through Canada Post. Allow 3 to 7 extra business days.

kb-12.title: Package marked delivered but missing
kb-12.text: If tracking says delivered but you can't find the package, wait 48 hours and check with your neighbours. Then contact us and we'll open a trace with the courier.

kb-13.title: Return window
kb-13.text: You can return items within 30 days of delivery, unused and in the original packaging.

kb-14.title: When refunds arrive
kb-14.text: Refunds go back to your original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after we receive your return.

kb-15.title: Return shipping costs
kb-15.text: Returns of defective items get a free return label. For other returns, a $6 return shipping fee is taken off your refund.

kb-16.title: Printing a return label
kb-16.text: Start a return from Orders > Return item and print the label. If you don't have a printer, choose the QR code option and show it at any Canada Post counter.

kb-17.title: Damaged or defective items
kb-17.text: Report damaged or defective items within 7 days of delivery, with photos. We'll send a replacement or give a full refund, whichever you prefer.

kb-18.title: Items you can't return
kb-18.text: Gift cards, final-sale items and opened personal care products can't be returned.

kb-19.title: Orders you didn't place
kb-19.text: If you see orders you didn't place, lock your account right away in Settings > Security > Lock account, then contact our fraud team. We will never ask for your password.

kb-20.title: Phishing messages
kb-20.text: We never ask for your password or full card number by email, text or phone. Forward suspicious messages to phishing@example.com and delete them.

kb-21.title: Unexpected password reset emails
kb-21.text: A password reset link is valid for 30 minutes. If you get reset emails you didn't request, someone typed your email address: change your password and turn on two-factor authentication.

kb-22.title: Two-factor authentication
kb-22.text: Turn on two-factor authentication in Settings > Security > Two-factor. You can use an authenticator app or text messages.

kb-23.title: Card charges you don't recognise
kb-23.text: Dispute a charge you don't recognise within 60 days. Confirmed fraud is refunded within 10 business days.

kb-24.title: Deleting your account
kb-24.text: Delete your account in Settings > Privacy > Delete account. Your data is removed within 30 days.

kb-25.title: Pausing your plan
kb-25.text: You can pause your plan for up to 3 months from Settings > Billing > Pause plan. You aren't charged while it's paused.
